sections.title: Roof replacement contractor serving McAllen
paras: Edel Roofing is based in Edinburg, about 15 minutes from central McAllen, and has replaced roofs across Hidalgo County since 2003. McAllen is one of the fastest-growing cities in Texas, which means two things at once: a lot of homes from the 80s and 90s around 2nd Street and 10th Street are reaching the end of their shingle life, and a lot of newer construction in north McAllen is going up around Sharyland and Las Cumbres.

A full replacement is the right call when a roof is past patching, widespread granule loss, multiple repair points, storm damage across a large area, or age alone once a shingle system passes 20-25 years in this climate. We inspect the whole roof and the decking underneath before recommending replacement over repair, not the other way around.
Every replacement includes a full tear-off, a decking inspection for water damage, and a written scope before we start.

cards.title: Full Tear-Off & Replacement
cards.body: Complete removal of the old roofing system down to the decking, inspection for water damage, and installation of a new shingle system with a written scope and timeline.

cards.title: CertainTeed, Owens Corning & GAF Shingles
cards.body: We install shingle systems from all three major manufacturers, and we're the only CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster in the Rio Grande Valley, a certification tied to installation quality and warranty coverage.

cards.title: Decking Repair & Replacement
cards.body: Water-damaged or rotted decking found during tear-off is repaired or replaced before the new roof goes on. This gets caught and documented, not covered up.

cards.title: Ventilation & Underlayment Upgrades
cards.body: Proper attic ventilation and modern synthetic underlayment matter in McAllen's heat. We can upgrade both during a replacement to extend the life of the new roof.

cards.title: New Construction & Remodel Roofing
cards.body: Roofing for new builds and additions in the growing north McAllen subdivisions, coordinated with builders and general contractors.

cards.title: Insurance Replacement Support
cards.body: When a replacement is being covered through a storm damage claim, we document our findings clearly so you know what to present to your insurance company.

sections.title: Why McAllen roofs need replacing sooner than you'd think
paras: Extreme heat and constant UV exposure age a shingle roof faster in the RGV than in most of the country. A 20-year shingle in McAllen often behaves more like a 15-year shingle by the time it's actually inspected. That's what we see most often in the older neighborhoods around 2nd Street and 10th Street, homes with roofs original to the 1980s and 90s construction, well past their realistic service life even if they don't look dramatically bad from the street.

In the newer areas around Sharyland and Las Cumbres in north McAllen, replacements are more often storm-driven, hail or wind damage across enough of the roof that patching stops making financial sense compared to a full replacement covered by insurance.
Either way, we walk the whole roof before recommending replacement, and we tell you plainly if a repair would actually do the job.

faqs.q: How do I know if my McAllen roof needs replacing instead of repairing?
faqs.a: Widespread granule loss, multiple leak points, a roof over 20-25 years old, or storm damage across a large section of the roof are the usual signs. We inspect the whole roof and decking and give you an honest recommendation, not an automatic upsell to replacement.

faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost in McAllen?
faqs.a: For a typical McAllen home, a full shingle replacement generally runs between $8,000 and $18,000, depending on roof size, pitch, current material, and shingle grade. We give a written estimate before any work begins.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential replacements in McAllen take one to three days depending on roof size and complexity, weather permitting. We give you a specific timeline as part of the written scope before work starts.

faqs.q: What shingle brands do you install in McAllen?
faqs.a: CertainTeed, Owens Corning, and GAF. We're the only CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster in the Rio Grande Valley, which reflects installation training and gives access to stronger warranty coverage on CertainTeed systems.

faqs.q: How do I get a roof replacement estimate in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We'll walk the roof, measure, and give you a written estimate. Estimates are free with no obligation.
